crossRefs.note: One of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand.
David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod here.”
Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,
Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s…
Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God’s ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.
Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell…
Sheva was scribe, and Zadok and Abiathar were priests,
He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.
King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also…
To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields; for you are worthy of death. But I will not…
So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to Yahweh, that he might fulfill Yahweh’s word, which he spoke…
Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of…
They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not…
“You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.

people.name: Abiathar
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

translations.web: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”
translations.bsb: During the high priesthood of Abiathar, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which was lawful only for the priests. And he gave some to his companions as well.”
translations.kjv: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
translations.asv: How he entered into the house of God when Abiathar was high priest, and ate the showbread, which it is not lawful to eat save for the priests, and gave also to them that were with him?
